lines: What happens when the machines can't read your label?
It got wet in the rain.
The box is pulled out of the flow.
Now, a photo of the label goes to a person.
When UPS showed how this works, that person had about ten seconds to figure out the ZIP code.
If even that fails, someone checks the box by hand.
And sometimes the problem isn't one label.
On the night of April second, 2025, with severe storms on the way, UPS suspended its Next Day Air sort in Louisville and canceled incoming domestic flights.
When the center of the network stops, the whole network feels it.
